subject.title: fix(android): keep composer media with its chat

question: Does the Android owner approve shipping the version 4-to-8 cache and outbox migration that parks legacy ownerless rows for manual re-entry or deletion rather than replaying them under an unproven agent owner?
rationale: Repository policy requires explicit acceptance for a SQLite schema-version bump, and this intentional fail-closed upgrade behavior changes what existing users experience even though it prevents cross-chat replay.

options.title: Approve fail-closed migration
options.body: Accept the tested manual-recovery behavior as the safest upgrade contract and merge after exact-head Android gates complete.

options.title: Require live upgrade proof
options.body: Hold merge until an emulator or device upgrade from a legacy database visibly confirms queued, accepted, cached-session, and recovery-row behavior.

options.title: Revise recovery semantics
options.body: Rework the migration if Android owners want a different recovery path while still forbidding automatic replay under an unproven owner.

recommendation.title: Approve fail-closed migration
recommendation.body: Accept the tested manual-recovery behavior as the safest upgrade contract and merge after exact-head Android gates complete.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored and consolidated the owner-binding, migration, and recovery implementation and is best positioned to confirm its intended upgrade contract.
